visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of image tiles with a short caption overlaid on a dark gradient at the bottom; no title or CTA
visualCharacteristics.description: 4 image tiles with caption overlaid at bottom | 4 image tiles with caption overlaid | 2 image tiles with caption overlaid | Image tiles in a row with short caption overlaid on a dark gradient at the bottom; no title/CTA

contentPattern.description: Look-alike image+caption items that flow and wrap

usage: Galleries comparing image variants (crop, colour, composite transformations) with a caption per tile.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for captioned image galleries. For cards with title and CTA use cards-tour.
